test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"raise"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number **2** is** 'raise.'**
 
• **Raise:** to cause something to increase or become bigger, better, higher, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** *The government plan to **raise** taxes.*
 
 
 
• **To raise money*** *is a phrase that means **to collect, to gather, to get or to put together money**.
